items.text: The Mission night sent us home with one assignment — one small act, lined up with your downhill mission
“One sentence each, whoever wants: what was your one act, or what got in the way?”
“‘I didn’t get to it’ is an honest sentence.” A parent opens; pass anytime
“The works were prepared beforehand; we keep walking into them. That assignment doesn’t expire.”
Nothing new gets taught tonight — on purpose. Everything we do, this room has already done
See one, do one, in front of each other — every one of us who is willing, not just the seniors headed for commissioning
“My turn is tonight. Somebody else’s turn is coming.”
This is not a competition — no ranking. The room’s job for every leader is the same: receive them
“The team is here. But the practice is ours now.”

panel.label: 1 TIMOTHY 4:12
lines: “Let no one despise you for your youth, but set the believers an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.”
